name: Save pipeline widget
description: Retired. The widget showed queued, running, done and dead counts for the old save pipeline. A saved dashboard that still holds the widget drops it silently on read, with no migration write. The status line (caught up, behind, stalled, rebuilding) lives in settings, pipeline, next to a rebuild button for each plugin.
where: Home screen once added: a cell titled save pipeline with a database mark.
The drawer's widget area at the bottom of the agents tab, once added.
how_to: Open the edit layout control at the bottom of the drawer.
Search widgets for save pipeline; press the card to put it on the home page, or press the one under drawer area to put it in the drawer.
Read the counts; press retry dead, shown only when a dead job exists, to requeue every dead job.
examples: See at once whether any job is dead and requeue it with retry dead.
media_exempt: A widget whose screenshots are captured before the next version bump.
